payload.title: Factory routing investigation — read-only findings

payload.assessment: Factory appears to be a server-side OpenAI concept (task dispatch infrastructure), not a local component. The laptop has no visibility into server-side routing decisions. The codex_session_dispatch_not_registered error you cited is consistent with a server-side dispatch registry, not something I can inspect.
payload.what_this_means: If Factory intercepts delegated tasks server-side before they reach a host, that would explain the native-tool difference — but I cannot observe it from here. The investigation would need server-side logs or OpenAI-side tooling I don't have.
